newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - May 15.
newsitem.headline: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - May 15.

text.p: Following are views on the direction of Philippine stocks on Thursday and main factors likely to affect trading:

* The Manila share index is likely to retrace to the 2,700 point level and establish that as a support but if it fails, the market will revert to the narrow 2,600-2,700 range, Sun Hung Kai Securities said.
* Investor reticence will continue before the U.S. Federal Reserve meeting on May 20 and the release of Gross National Product (GNP) figures, said BPI Securities Corp analyst Spencer Yap.
